title: Bea Millan-Windorski excited to bring Pinoy spirit to Miss Universe 2026
summary: Miss Universe Philippines 2026 Bea Millan-Windorski is excited to carry the Filipino spirit to Puerto Rico, where she will represent the country at the Miss Universe pageant on November 25.
